Construct a reference printer with a custom path callback. The signature is <span class="pre">`(target:`</span>` `<span class="pre">`Element,`</span>` `<span class="pre">`referent:`</span>` `<span class="pre">`Element)`</span>` `<span class="pre">`->`</span>` `<span class="pre">`Sequence[str]`</span>` `<span class="pre">`|`</span>` `<span class="pre">`NamePreference`</span>, where:

- <span class="pre">`target`</span> is the element that is referenced. Callback should return the path to it.

- <span class="pre">`referent`</span> is the referent element, e.g. <span class="pre">`Membership`</span>.

Callback may also choose to return a name preference which will be used to print the reference instead.
